description: This is a Linux kernel driver source file for the RV5C386A Real Time Clock (RTC) used in WL-HDD devices, implementing RTC read/write and ioctl operations, platform detection, and I2C communication.

methods.name: rtc_open
methods.description: Opens the RTC device, initializes I2C, and locks the device.

methods.name: rtc_release
methods.description: Releases the RTC device and unlocks it.

methods.name: rtc_read
methods.description: Reads current RTC time and outputs it in a formatted string.

methods.name: rtc_write
methods.description: Sets RTC time based on input string in format 'YYYY:MM:DD:W:HH:MM:SS\n'.

methods.name: rtc_ioctl
methods.description: Handles ioctl commands for reading and setting RTC time.

methods.name: get_rtc_time
methods.description: Reads time from RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: set_rtc_time
methods.description: Writes time to RTC hardware via I2C.

methods.name: platform_detect
methods.description: Detects platform-specific GPIO pin configuration for RTC communication.

methods.name: rtc_init
methods.description: Initializes the RTC driver, detects platform, switches to 24h mode, and registers device.

methods.name: rtc_exit
methods.description: Cleans up and deregisters the RTC device.
